linear_solver_health.semantics: every parsed solve must be finite, have positive bounded iterations, and meet max(absolute_tolerance, relative_tolerance*initial_residual) for its actual base fvSolution solver

pimple_terminal_convergence.semantics: the final parsed solve of each required field in each time step; evaluated against terminal pFinal/UFinal absolute tolerance after preflight confirms the configuration

legacy_metric.name: max_final_residual_across_all_parsed_Solving_for_lines_per_time
legacy_metric.reason: it includes intermediate PIMPLE/PISO solves and is not a terminal-timestep convergence metric

startup_policy.reason: no exemption is needed or justified: run_008 terminal per-field values satisfy this contract from the first step
